lastResponse.text: Most important number: five four one, seven seven two, three eight two eight, extension one. That’s Street. Vincent de Paul in Medford for rent and utility help, at 2424 North Pacific Highway. If extension is hard, call the same number without it: five four one, seven seven two, three eight two eight. They may ask for ID, income proof, and your rental agreement.
originalTexts: Most important number: **five four one, seven seven two, three eight two eight, extension one**. That’s St. Vincent de Paul in Medford for rent and utility help, at **2424 North Pacific Highway**. If extension is hard, call the same number without it: **five four one, seven seven two, three eight two eight**. They may ask for ID, income proof, and your rental agreement.
